stem: During her school garden walk, Meera picks up a fallen mango leaf and a fallen blade of grass. She looks carefully at the thin lines (veins) on both leaves. Explain how Meera can decide which leaf has reticulate venation and which has parallel venation from the pattern of their veins.

teacher.key_rationale: Full marks: the learner states that the thin lines are veins and their pattern is venation; the mango leaf shows a net-like pattern of veins spreading on both sides of a thick middle vein, so it has reticulate venation; the grass blade shows veins running parallel to each other, so it has parallel venation. Partial credit for naming the correct pattern for only one leaf or for describing net-like versus parallel veins without assigning them to the correct leaf.
